arabic: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَعْقِدُ التَّسْبِيحَ بِيَمِينِهِ.
transliteration: The Prophet (peace be upon him) used to count the Tasbeeh on his right hand.
translation: Abdullah bin 'Amr (RA) said: 'I saw the Prophet (peace be upon him) counting the glorification of Allah on his right hand.'
reference: Abu Dawud 2/81, At-Tirmidhi 5/521, authenticated by Al-Albani
